headline.primary: Put purpose at the centre of the student journey.
headline.secondary: Connect the course, wider experiences and support around it.

intro: The course remains the academic foundation of a King's education. King's Edge helps students connect it with wider experiences, relationships and future possibilities through an evolving sense of what matters to them and how they may want to contribute.

items.title: The value of a degree is less certain than it once was.
items.statement: Students need an education that develops knowledge, judgement and capability, together with clearer evidence of what they can contribute. This matters especially for international students making a major investment in a King's education.

items.title: Connect the whole student experience.
items.statement: King's Edge will help students connect their course with experiences, opportunities, support and recognition. The aim is a more coherent journey, not a new layer of activity.

problem.label: The challenge
problem.summary: King's offers many valuable experiences, but students do not always experience them as connected, easy to navigate or equally available.
problem.detail: Strong practice already exists across King's, but it varies by course and is not always visible to students. Opportunities and support are spread across different teams and systems, so students who already know how the university works can find it easier to benefit. King's Edge will connect and extend what works, while strengthening provision where students have fewer opportunities or poorer outcomes.

leadership.title: Start with the student's developing purpose.
leadership.intro: Universities usually organise the wider student experience around the course. King's will keep the course at the centre of academic life, while helping students use their developing interests, values and ambitions to make sense of the choices around it.

items.title: Start with purpose
items.statement: Help students explore what matters to them, what they want to learn and how they may wish to contribute. Purpose can change, and uncertainty is a valid starting point.

items.title: Connect the experience
items.statement: Make it easier for students to connect their course with wider experiences, opportunities, relationships and support.

items.title: Relate learning to possible futures
items.statement: Help students understand how their disciplinary education and wider development may matter in a changing society and economy, without reducing education to job preparation.

items.title: Use evidence to improve
items.statement: Help students show what they have learned and use evidence across King's to improve courses, opportunities and support.

leadership.claim: Many universities offer these elements separately. King's Edge will connect them around the student and improve the experience over time.

mechanismIntro.title: Four things need to work together.
mechanismIntro.summary: King's must strengthen what students experience, help them understand how it connects, support them to make meaningful choices and recognise what they have learned.

mechanisms.title: Strengthen the experience
mechanisms.formalTitle: Improve the quality and reach of the student experience
mechanisms.summary: King's will use evidence and student insight to strengthen courses and wider experiences, extend good practice and improve provision where opportunities or outcomes are weaker.

levers.title: Use evidence to improve
levers.description: Course teams and institutional leaders identify strengths, gaps and uneven outcomes, then act through normal enhancement and investment processes.

levers.title: Design meaningful learning
levers.description: Courses and wider experiences give students opportunities to apply knowledge, exercise judgement, build relationships and respond to real challenges.

levers.title: Extend access
levers.description: Access to strong developmental experiences becomes less dependent on course, background, networks, confidence or discretionary time.

mechanisms.causalClaim: Students are more likely to develop lasting knowledge, judgement and capability when they encounter high-quality experiences and receive appropriate support. Evidence helps King's strengthen what works and act where the experience is weaker.
outcomes: More students encounter meaningful developmental experiences.
Courses and opportunities become clearer about what students can learn and practise.
Differences in opportunity and outcomes reduce over time.

mechanisms.title: Connect the value
mechanisms.formalTitle: Help students understand how learning and experience connect
mechanisms.hook: Help students see how their learning and experiences fit together.
mechanisms.summary: King's will make it easier for students and staff to see how knowledge, skills, experiences, relationships and possible futures connect across the course and wider student experience.

levers.title: Make development clearer
levers.description: Courses and opportunities describe what students may learn or practise without treating participation alone as proof of capability.

levers.title: Use shared language
levers.description: A clear common language helps connect courses, skills, wider experiences and possible futures while preserving disciplinary difference.

levers.title: Create time for reflection
levers.description: Prompts, conversations and reflection help students interpret their development and decide which claims they can support.

mechanisms.causalClaim: When students can see how different parts of their experience connect, they are more likely to recognise their development, apply learning in new settings and make informed choices about what to do next.
outcomes: Students have clearer language for understanding their development.
Students can connect disciplinary learning, skills, wider experiences and future possibilities.
Students carry less of the burden of making sense of fragmented systems.

mechanisms.title: Support purposeful choices
mechanisms.formalTitle: Help students choose and act with purpose
mechanisms.hook: Help students decide what matters and act on it.
mechanisms.summary: King's will help students explore what matters to them, make informed choices and shape a meaningful journey through their course and the wider King's experience.

levers.title: Keep purpose open
levers.description: Students revisit their interests, ambitions, needs and possible contribution throughout their time at King's. They are not expected to arrive with a fixed career plan.

levers.title: Offer relevant support
levers.description: Connected information, digital tools and human relationships help students identify realistic next steps when support is most useful.

levers.title: Make navigation easier
levers.description: Simpler routes and more joined-up provision reduce the advantage held by students who already know how to find and combine opportunities.

mechanisms.causalClaim: When students can relate available choices to what matters to them, and have the support to act, they are more likely to participate intentionally and build a journey that makes sense to them.
outcomes: Students make more intentional choices about their learning and development.
Participation is better connected to students' interests, needs and possible futures.
King's uses student demand and experience to shape provision more effectively.

mechanisms.title: Recognise and learn
mechanisms.formalTitle: Help students evidence development and help King's learn
mechanisms.hook: Make development credible and use the evidence to improve.
mechanisms.summary: King's will help students capture and explain what they have learned, while using combined evidence carefully to improve courses, opportunities and support.

levers.title: Trusted records
levers.description: Academic achievement, recognised experiences, credentials and student evidence are connected while keeping clear what King's has certified, what is supported by evidence and what the student is claiming.

levers.title: Clearer articulation
levers.description: Students can choose relevant evidence and explain what they know, can do and contribute for different audiences and purposes.

levers.title: Institutional learning
levers.description: Evidence from students, courses, graduate destinations and external partners shows where provision is strong, uneven or in need of improvement.

mechanisms.causalClaim: Students are better able to carry the value of their education forward when they can support and explain what they have learned. King's can improve the experience when it uses evidence to understand what is working and for whom.
outcomes: Students leave with credible evidence of their learning and development.
Courses and King's understand more clearly what the education enables.
Evidence informs improvement, support and investment.

executiveOutcomes.title: A better experience for students, faculties and King's.
executiveOutcomes.intro: King's Edge should make the student journey easier to understand, help faculties strengthen distinctive provision and give the university better evidence for action.

items.statement: A more coherent journey, fairer access to meaningful experiences and credible evidence of what they can contribute.
Useful insight and shared support to strengthen, connect and explain distinctive disciplinary provision.
A clearer view of where the student experience is strong, uneven or in need of attention and investment.

proofPoints.title: What we should see first
proofPoints.intro: The model should become visible through a small number of practical changes.

items.title: Purpose becomes part of the journey
items.statement: Every student is invited to explore and revisit what matters to them, without being expected to have a fixed plan.

items.title: Course teams get useful evidence
items.statement: Course teams can identify strengths, make credible claims and agree proportionate improvements.

items.title: Students can connect opportunities
items.statement: Courses, experiences, skills and possible futures are easier to find and understand together.

items.title: Students can show what they have learned
items.statement: Students build a credible account of learning and contribution throughout their time at King's.

operatingPrinciplesIntro.title: Led by faculties, supported across King's.
operatingPrinciplesIntro.summary: Delivery should preserve disciplinary ownership, provide shared support where it adds value and build in stages rather than promise everything at once.

facultyEnablement.title: Led by faculties, supported centrally
facultyEnablement.summary: Faculties own disciplinary interpretation and improvement. King's provides shared evidence, language, platforms and support where these are stronger when developed once.
facultyEnablement.detail: King's Edge will strengthen and connect existing practice rather than rebadge it. It will support local ownership, target additional help where capacity or outcomes are weaker and reduce the need for faculties to recreate common infrastructure.

deliveryPrinciple.title: Build in stages and reuse what works
deliveryPrinciple.summary: Shared capabilities will be tested and developed in stages, then reused across courses and services where they add clear value.
deliveryPrinciple.detail: Early deliverables will test the four mechanisms while building evidence, data, digital, opportunity and recognition capabilities. Wider rollout should follow only when benefits, ownership and ongoing costs are clear.

equity.eyebrow: Across every part of the model
equity.title: It must work for every student
equity.summary: A student's course, background, mode of study, confidence, prior networks or available time should not determine whether they can benefit.
equity.detail: King's must examine who encounters meaningful opportunities, who can understand and navigate them, whose development is recognised and whether different groups receive comparable value.

feedback.title: Use evidence to improve the experience
feedback.summary: Evidence from students, courses, graduate destinations and external partners should shape educational design, opportunities, support and investment.

northStar.statement: Every student can access, understand and show the value of their King's education.

deliveryCta.title: See how the plan delivers this
deliveryCta.summary: Explore the projects and deliverables through which King's Edge will test and build this approach.
deliveryCta.label: Explore the projects

hypothesis.if: King's strengthens the student experience, connects courses with wider opportunities, helps students make choices around an evolving sense of purpose and enables them to evidence what they have learned,
hypothesis.then: students will be better able to access meaningful opportunities, build a coherent journey and explain what they can contribute,
hypothesis.while: King's becomes better able to understand what is working, where the experience is uneven and where improvement or investment is needed.
